title: folder-sync restore request, version 1
description: <root>_requests/<project>/<host-id>/<id>.json: a restore the host <host-id> is asked to make (and, on a machine, ~/.folder-sync/projects/<key>/requests/<id>.json for its own files). Created once, with If-None-Match: *, by the accounts Worker or another of the person's devices. Only the host it names applies it; that host then writes `outcome` into the same key (If-Match on the request's ETag) and never deletes it. The pruner deletes it 30 days after `at`. See docs/CONTRACT.md, 'Restore requests'.

host.description: The host that owns every item's path, and equals the key's <host-id>.

name.description: A browser as /fs/v1/devices names it ("Chrome on Linux"), or a machine's host_name.

host.description: For kind=machine: the asking machine's host id.

outcome.description: Written by the host it names, once it ran. Each applied item is also a restore event (request = id) in that host's next change record.

seq.description: The manifest version that published the restored files; absent when nothing was published (every item failed, or each already held those bytes).

results.description: One per item, in item order.

error.description: pruned: the version is gone; mismatch: its bytes do not hash to its name; failed: anything else, with why.
